envelope.description: Guard local approval and approval of a target

body.title: Guard local approval and approval of a target
body.summary: In src/workflow/gates.ts make approveArtifactByJsonPath ask the gate for approve-local and throw TeamGateRefusedError before any review check or stamp, and make approveWorkflowTarget authorize each target before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion creates or merges its BUILD record: a Story-wide BUILD is authorized against every Task claim of the Story (or against the Story unit when the Story has no Task units) and refused naming the first Task held by someone else, a standalone BUILD against the standalone unit, and an approval that cannot resolve a unit is refused. A TeamGateRefusedError puts the target in skipped[] with the refusal reason. Format the refusal in the terminal approve case in src/cli/command.ts beside the review-block message. Signatures are unchanged and a repo with no policy behaves as before.
acceptanceChecks: approveArtifactByJsonPath throws TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder before any review check or stamp
A refused BUILD target creates no BUILD record, is in skipped[] with the reason, and the other targets are approved
A Story-wide BUILD is refused when any of the Story's Tasks is held by someone else and is authorized against the Story unit when it has no Tasks
The terminal approve command prints the refusal naming the holder
A repo with no policy approves exactly as before

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gate-approve.test.ts: approveArtifactByJsonPath throws TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder before any review check or stamp, and approveWorkflowTarget authorizes a BUILD target before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion so a refused target creates no BUILD record, puts it in skipped[] with the reason and approves the others
